description: This bar chart, from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," illustrates the average performance of five different methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClinGS (w/), and ClinGS. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," is scaled linearly from 0 to 60 with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the five methods in the order presented. Each method is represented by a single, solid-colored bar: Standard (brownish-orange), Self-RAG (darker brownish-gray), FactTune (greenish-gray), ClinGS (w/) (blue-gray), and ClinGS (dark blue). The bars are arranged in ascending order of performance from left to right, with the shortest bar corresponding to Standard at approximately 54, and the tallest bar corresponding to ClinGS at approximately 60. The other bars—Self-RAG, FactTune, and ClinGS (w/)—all have values clustered between approximately 54 and 58, with Self-RAG and FactTune appearing nearly identical in height and ClinGS (w/) slightly lower than ClinGS. There are no annotations, error bars, or additional visual emphasis on any specific bar.
